# Animation runtime

GSAP 3.15.0 and ScrollTrigger are copied unmodified from the npm `gsap` distribution. Embedded copyright and license notices remain in both files. Upstream documentation and license: https://gsap.com/docs/ and https://gsap.com/standard-license/ .

The prototype loads local copies so ordinary viewing makes no external animation-library request. No React conversion is required for this vanilla HTML prototype.
